ary companies shall reserve the full right to take suitable penal action as may be deemed fit including b anning of business, apart from forfeiture of EMD, Security Deposit etc. OR, 2. In such cases, documents mentioned under 1(a), 1 (b) and 1(c) a bove are not required for declaring them as OPM. OR, 3.
